verdict.rationale: Insomnia offers OpenAPI spec linting (inso lint spec) and design-time preview/linting, which helps catch spec-authoring errors, and test/collection-runner features could be scripted to assert on live responses, but there is no documented feature that automatically validates a live response against an OpenAPI contract to detect drift at runtime. missing for 10: dedicated contract-testing/schema-validation-against-live-response feature, automated drift detection/reporting, and independent evidence of this specific workflow working in practice.
